short_zones.label: Short on rejection or loss of momentum in the 80,000-81,600 liquidity and prior-high zone

no_trade_conditions: No entry without visible rejection or loss of momentum in the 80,000-81,600 zone
Do not short if price breaks and confirms above 82,500
Avoid trading while the contracting structure has no directional confirmation
notes: The video favors a tactical short after liquidity is taken near 80,000 or prior highs near 81,600. A confirmed move above 82,500 weakens the short thesis; a five-wave advance toward 88,000-90,000 would provide stronger bullish confirmation.
